abstract: Fifteen patients with malignant teratoma and twelve with squamous cancer of the head and neck received treatment with bleomycin. Routine measurements of carbon monoxide diffusing capacity (DLco) were performed. Both groups showed a gradual fall of similar magnitude in their DLco measurements during treatment. No patient in the group with squamous cancer developed clinical or radiological evidence of major pulmonary toxicity. Two of the teratoma patients suffered fatal pulmonary toxicity and their DLco measurements before any signs of major pulmonary toxicity were no different from the measurements of those patients who remained free of major clinical toxicity. The two patients who died both showed a sustained reduction in renal function during chemotherapy which may have been a major risk factor in the development of severe clinical toxicity. The magnitude of the decline in DLco in this series was not a useful predictor of those patients who developed severe and radiological toxicity.
abstract_ja: 悪性奇形腫の患者15例と頭頸部扁平上皮癌の患者12例がブレオマイシンによる治療を受けた。一酸化炭素拡散能(DLco)を定期的に測定した。両群ともに治療中にほぼ同程度の緩やかなDLcoの低下を示した。扁平上皮癌群では、臨床的または放射線学的に重篤な肺毒性を発症した患者はいなかった。奇形腫患者のうち2例は致死的な肺毒性を生じたが、重篤な臨床毒性の徴候が現れる前のDLco測定値は、臨床的に重大な毒性を発症しなかった患者と差がなかった。死亡した2例はいずれも化学療法中に持続的な腎機能低下を示しており、これが重篤な臨床毒性の発症における主要な危険因子であった可能性がある。本研究では、DLcoの低下の程度は重篤な放射線学的毒性を発症した患者を予測する有用な指標とはならなかった。
